description: Asks whether trailing spaces, NBSP and tab are significant to LIKE, '=', StrComp and Len (Pat group p12, plus a WHERE S = 'A' selection that may use index IX_S). Asks whether a literal pattern matches the whole subject or a substring (MN against group p14). Asks the outcomes, not the timing, of long wildcard patterns ending in a mismatch (group p17). One projection per group. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
